display.panel: CSOT m81_42_02_0b NT36532 TDDI, dual DSI, DSC, video mode (stock Panel_M81_42_02_0b_dualdsi_dsc_lcd_video.xml)
display.backlight: KTZ8866 on QUP0 i2c1 address 0x11, enable gpio6; left on by the ABL, no XNU driver yet

identity.comment: The iPad7,11 / J171AP identity of the restore itself; liuqin is a tablet, so no phone presentation layer.

touch.comment: QUP0 SE4 CS0, 9.6 MHz, IRQ gpio21, no reset line; no XNU driver yet, so no driver matches this node

boot.comment: One fastboot boot, RAM only: the stock ABL starts the kernel slot (gzip BootShim + UEFI FD, then the stock Cape SoC DTB it selects by msm-id) and hands the ramdisk (vendor ramdisk of vendor_boot, 21.7 MiB, then the PONGFAT1 payload) to the firmware through /chosen linux,initrd-*; PongBootMemoryDxe scans that range, at most 128 MiB.
boot.label: Xiaomi Pad 6 Pro / liuqin / SM8475
